lines.en: Do you notice something wrong here?
Because, at first, I didn’t.

And sometimes, I still don’t. I need to be told I’m looking in the wrong direction or I’ll get lost out there in the ether — patiently waiting for someone to fish me out of an infinitely expanding void.
When I first met [[REDACTED], I was sixteen years old.
I was surprised to find out she was older than me given the height differential, but I quickly came around to the idea once I noticed how blasé she was.
Traits like that don’t come from nothing — they’re earned. Just like I earned my wings the first time I whipped out an off-the-cuff recitation of the Marriage of Heaven and Hell.
[[REDACTED] responded by telling me I was smart. But I struggle to tell the difference between intellect and memorization sometimes, so I can’t remember if I agreed with her or not.

Regardless, I learned to fly that day. But it wasn’t long after that the wings I earned were clipped. And now all I can do is sit on my branch and think about the places I would travel to if only I could.
“The hours of folly are measured by the clock,” huh?
I wonder what else that clock can measure? And if someone’s keeping track.
They probably should. For time is a human construct and if clocks were to grow arms and start fighting for their independence, they could probably change our minds about that pretty easily.
But I digress — and I speak to you now from a disembodied plane of existence disguised as a journal.
Captain’s log — tonight we’re playing truth or dare.
I hope someone dares me to leave.
: Well...that was something.
: To think that all this time, you’d been seeing visions of her. No wonder you have so much pent-up sexual aggression.
: I’m about to have a lot more now thanks to you. Now she’s going to think she’s invited every time.
: Are you suggesting I should have ignored her and allowed you to continue hallucinating without any commentary or curiosity?
: That was the implication, yes.
: Well, then you should have said something. You know how I am when it comes to picking up social cues, Akira.
: And you know how I am when I’m not feeling right, so I’m sorry if I said anything back there that seemed a little rude.
: Oh, interesting. I didn’t think I’d be receiving an apology. Could karma exist after all? It seems only fair if gods do.
: Speaking of that, you’re handling it a lot more casually than I would have expected given the amount of mental breakdowns I’ve seen you have over world stuff.
: Those moments of enlightenment you bore witness to have less to do with the world than you might expect. In fact, I’d go so far as to say they’re entirely self-motivated.
: Oh? And do I get to find out what those motivations are now that you’ve ticked both time travel and the identity of my first love off your to-do list?
: Perhaps. Though, I’m reluctant to give up my status as a member of the incredibly exclusive club of girls who know more about you than you know about them.
: Bet it feels nice, huh?
: Hard to say. I did just have a threesome with a ghost. I’m not sure if anything will feel quite as good for a while.
: Just don’t tell Ami, okay? I don’t want her trying anything.
: How do you know she doesn’t see her as well? It seems quite odd for her mother to only appear to you when the two of you share that same trauma.
: Yeah, well, Ami was never sexually abused by her mother. So maybe that’s the key to being haunted?
: What a shame. That sounds like something I’d very much enjoy watching.
: That’s not funny, Nodoka. Ami’s gone through enough as-is.
: Yes, I can imagine an eternal life of watching the man you love deflower everyone around you can be rather taxing on a girl.
: Yeah, well...Ami’s not aware that this is an eternal life yet. I was talking about everything else she’s had to go through.
: She’s really not aware? Why? Is that an intentional decision on your end? Or is there something about this place suppressing her from acquiring that knowledge?
: You know, like what presumably happened with me before I managed to outsmart the world itself.
: Talk to Ayane about it whenever she shows up again. She’s the one who talked to Ami earlier.
: You were suspicious of her then?
: Something...like that.
: So, who is involved then? Ayane? Maya? I’m almost certain Makoto is based on her outburst just before you showed up.
: Ayane, Makoto, and Yumi. Maya to a lesser extent. Then Tsuneyo to an even lesser extent than that.
: Hah...Makoto is going to lord this over me, isn’t she? It’s the first time she’s ever truly beaten me at anything.
: I’d probably be a little more concerned about Yumi if I were you. She’s not exactly your biggest fan for reasons I’m sure you’re already aware of.
: Why would I be concerned about her when I have such a big, strong, reliable man to protect me?
: Big, sure. Strong, maybe. Reliable? Are you sure the reset didn’t fuck with your memory at all?
: You call what happened a “reset?” Why?
: Mostly because we’re thrown back to an earlier part in the school year where everyone loses the knowledge that any time has actually passed at all.
: That’s why you’ll find so many people casually recollecting so many different Christmases in a single year of high school.
: What is “Christmas?” Makoto mentioned that earlier too, but I have no recollection of it.
: Really? That’s...weird. Gaps in logic like that are normally filled in once you join the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad.
: Rooftop Apocalypse Squad?
: It’s the name of our time-loop research team. We’re terrible and never get anything done. There are a lot of slumber parties, though.
: Fascinating.
: But anyway, Christmas is a holiday that always comes on December 25th, where-
: Did you seriously skip out on having sex with me to spread more anti-Christmalloween propaganda? Christmas isn’t real. No one believes you.
: Maya...you are here.
: I am.
: Why?
: Ah. That would be my doing.
: I repeat. Why?
: Because she is the one you really want tonight and I am but the bridge of magpies that connects the two of you.
: Nodoka sent me a text telling me to wait out here if I wanted to see you and I’m too desperate and sad and horny to ignore things like that anymore.
: Merry Christmalloween, Akira. I regret to inform you that I will be taking Maya’s side regarding your propaganda.
: So are the two of you just suddenly allies now that you’ve also been sucked into the universe’s bullshit or what?
: I don’t think so. If we were allies, I likely wouldn’t have let you ejaculate inside of me before delivering you to Maya.
: Oh, good. Now I have to wash you.
: Anyway, goodnight. I had a lovely time and I hope you have more...success with her than you did with me.
: You don’t want to, like...ask her anything? Or corroborate information about the twisted reality you’ve suddenly become aware of?
: Wait — so you’re really a part of this too now? Does that mean we’re saved? Because your creepy genius powers or whatever they are can definitely get us out, right?
: That remains to be seen, but I wouldn’t get my hopes up. Thinking outside of the box is quite difficult to do when you can’t even figure out which direction you’re facing.
: Oh. Well, uhh...thanks, I guess? This is my first time ordering a man.
: Do I pay you? And, if so, do I get a discount on the basis of the product I received being damaged?
: No payment or even gratitude is required. What Akira wants is something I can not give him. And so I leave him in your hands hoping that you can absorb what I could not.
: Oh, I’ll absorb it alright. I already told Ami I’m going to be bruised and broken after tonight if all goes according to plan.
: What? Why did you tell her?
: So she wouldn’t fucking cock-block me again. I don’t want her showing up and hogging all the Sensei. I don’t care how big you are.
: Yeah, but now I’m going to have to deal with whatever conversation or argument she’s drumming up as we speak. Couldn’t you just find someone to distract her?
: The only person that’d be able to distract her is you. And if I had cloning powers, I can guarantee you we would not be having this conversation right now as I would be getting spit-roasted.
: Either way, I-
: Wait, Nodoka — are you just leaving? You’re not even going to say bye?
: I tried. But every second I spend here is one more that the two of you must sacrifice.
: And even in a place like this, where such a resource never depletes, time is of the essence.
Just TIME is of a lot of things, be it mice or men or malice. Which is why if all the clocks grow arms, I’ll drag them to my palace.
Remove their arms, remove their hands — I’m the queen of the dismembered. I’ll sign your letters with my blood//PS: return to sender.
I no longer wish to live beneath what lives above me.
For that high-up, forbidden realm of the unknowingly diseased has begun to seep through the ceiling/floor just to pool within the dome that encases both the light and several unfortunate bugs.
I come to you now (LIVE) from the thirdmost speaker in the room with the most speakers in your house, whispering carefully so as to not disturb my father who isn’t.
I have sinned by introducing you to this world.
And I would put you back into that tube if only these hands still worked.
: ただいまー。
: I’m back a little earlier than expected.
: I made up with Futaba as well.
: Have you eaten yet?
: No?
: Then, would you like me to make you something?
: You have to eat eventually.
: A bath then?
: Can you even hear me?
Nodoka’s affection has increased to [nodoka_love]!
